headline: A federal law renames the VA medical center in Memphis, Tennessee, after Lt. Col. Luke Weathers, Jr.
what_it_does: This law officially names the Department of Veterans Affairs medical center in Memphis, Tennessee, the Lt. Col. Luke Weathers, Jr. VA Medical Center. It is a naming measure and does not change how the hospital is run, funded, or what care it provides. The law was signed on December 20, 2022.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 20, 2022.
